dishes.name: Konya etli ekmek
dishes.desc: Thin, long dough topped with seasoned minced meat and baked in a very hot oven. It looks like lahmacun but is a different dish, and Konya's best-known meal.

dishes.name: Fırın kebabı
dishes.desc: Lamb ribs and foreleg slow-cooked for hours in a wood oven in their own fat, served with raw onion. A Konya kebap-house classic.

dishes.name: Bamya çorbası
dishes.desc: Soup of dried okra strung on thread, with small cubes of veal and lemon juice. A Konya wedding and festive-table soup.

dishes.name: Konya su böreği
dishes.desc: Layers of handmade yufka dough, boiled first and then baked, eaten hot in the morning with black tea. A staple of Konya breakfast tables.

dishes.name: Sacarası
dishes.desc: Sweet traditionally baked between two griddles over wood embers, though oven versions exist. A homely Konya dessert found in local sweet shops.
